rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose, formal-leaning verb for declaring or asserting a belief, opinion, or fact.

example.english: They profess that they never received that money at the press conference.
example.traditional: 佢喺記者會上聲稱自己冇收過嗰筆錢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gei3 ze2 wui2 soeng5 sing1 cing1 zi6 gei2 mou5 sau1 gwo3 go2 bat1 cin4

rows.note: Use this when someone claims to be or have something, especially when the claim may be doubtful.

example.english: They profess to be an expert, but cannot even answer basic questions.
example.traditional: 佢自稱係專家，但係連基本問題都答唔到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zi6 cing1 hai6 zyun1 gaa1 daan6 hai6 lin4 gei1 bun2 man6 tai4 dou1 daap3 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for adhering to a religion, deity, or principle, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: They profess Buddhism and eat vegetarian food on the first day of every lunar month.
example.traditional: 佢一向信奉佛教，逢初一都會食齋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 seon3 fung6 fat6 gaau3 fung4 co1 jat1 dou1 wui6 sik6 zaai1
